primaryPath: API DockerExecutionProvider -> runner-owned admission/validation/container policy -> pinned Deno -> execution-scoped Host Gateway -> authenticated API enqueue -> PostgreSQL -> authenticated SecureBridge -> Paper -> confirmed command result. Advisory analysis and optional OTLP export remain separate.
importantBoundaries: Runner is trusted and owns Docker socket and execution policy. No generic Docker proxy.
Deno network reachability is transport, not capability authority. Gateway public/admin listeners differ.
Queue origin/correlation derives from authenticated gateway and trusted execution/trace DB mapping, never sandbox payload metadata.
Only chat.broadcast is sandboxAccessible; server.status/player_list are backend-only; events/inventory/console remain unimplemented roadmap.
Analysis failure has null classification and cannot change sandbox outcome. Audit access/check records do not assert grant or denial.
OTel spans are synthesized by trusted API from stored results; collector receipt is separately verified.
One runner admission process is not a distributed deployment-wide scheduler.
